name: QwenPaw Console Turn Notifications
description:
Native Windows toast notifications for completed QwenPaw console turns. Fixed text: “QwenPaw has completed the turn.” Windows only (v1). No browser notification, no console UI and no response content storage.

QwenPaw 控制台对话完成时显示原生 Windows 通知。固定文本：“QwenPaw has completed the turn.” 仅支持 Windows（v1）。不使用浏览器通知，不添加控制台界面，也不保存回复内容。
author: BigBunnyBall大兔子球
